INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

TO: Investment Committee
FROM: Alex Donovan
DATE: November 10, 2020
RE: Houston Multifamily Acquisition

The subject property is a 232-unit garden-style multifamily community
located in Houston's Westchase submarket.

PROPERTY IDENTIFICATION:
The asset known as "Oakwood Commons at Westchase" (also referred to
by brokers as "the Houston deal" or "OC Houston") is being offered
at $41.2M.

This file tests whether REMI can identify that "Oakwood Commons"
is the property when the filename contains no property reference.
